title: Trusted Context Method (TCM): Open Method v1.5 — Open Edition 1.0
description: An original authorial, evidence-oriented methodology with seven stages, seven artifacts, seven Gates and three independent control dimensions. Includes a full Russian normative reference and an author-reviewed English editorial translation (not independently certified). The public-method specifications and seven templates are authorized by the author for CC BY-SA 4.0 distribution; commercial course materials are excluded. Independent validation is invited.
